entities.summary: Francesco Pianeta is an Italian former professional boxer who competed from 2005 to 2018. He challenged once for the unified WBA (Super), IBF, WBO, IBO, The Ring magazine heavyweight titles in 2013; and once for the WBA (Regular) heavyweight title in 2015. He holds a notable win over former world heavyweight champion Oliver McCall.
